blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Килиану Мбаппе всего девятнадцать ___ (год, gen. pl.).
exercises.prompt: Kylian Mbappé is only 19 years old.
exercises.why: Masculine nouns in **-й** have **-ев** in the genitive plural: **трамвай** — **трамваев**. — DLI, Lesson 39.
exercises.context: Masculine nouns in **-й** have **-ев** in the genitive plural: **трамвай** — **трамваев**.
